Intake note (Commercial team, 01/03/2020). Our client Sameer Shinde is a 72-year-old schoolteacher who lives at Bungalow 34, Chembur, Mumbai 400009 and can be reached on +91 97531 42182 or sameer.shinde@example.com. The client's PAN USRPS3066Y.
The client consulted us about a wrongful termination matter against Sai Industries. The wrongful termination claim against M/s Sai Industries is for ₹15,80,000; the employee was dismissed without any enquiry.
The matter was filed as Complaint No. 1646/2020 before the Mumbai Labour Court on 27 June 2020.
